online.comparison: 公開API・提出全文で現行9ec6版と一致。前回比約31%短縮。別時点のオンライン測定であり、ローカルの固定条件比較とは区別する。

environment.main_and_io: 同じdriver/共通入出力を固定。各コア別flock、中央値と同一実行ファイルcontrolを併用。周波数は固定していない。

decisions.scalar: 完全4子選択は同一binary controlの変動と同程度。下降ループ分離は公式合計約4%増。比較値キャッシュ・8分岐は大規模の削除/回収に大幅な退行。
decisions.normalize: 上昇の交互化・push書戻し省略・低頻度分岐は公式で確かな改善なし。normalize強制インラインはtop連続が小規模約5倍/大規模約11%増。
decisions.root_equal: 末尾と根の一致時だけ復元を省く案は、公式mainの短縮を再現できない。
decisions.prefetch_common_child: 公式の500000初期要素8条件は短縮したが、初期空の条件や大規模APIが悪化。8192/65536/131072/262144の切替えを比較。
decisions.prefetch_restore: 復元だけ先読みする3形も構築・単体操作の退行が残る。
decisions.prefetch_poponly: 構築と遅延相殺を元のまま残して大きな先頭削除だけ先読み。公式大8ケースは約5〜14%短縮をrootも確認したが、通常設定で最大方向の反復push/top/popが500000要素約6.9%、1000000要素約7.0%増。nativeの1000000要素で重複の多い操作が最小方向約7.7%、最大方向約10.0%増。関数分離/強制インラインでも解消しない。

adoption: 現在の4分岐9ec6版と全API/所有権/main/IOを維持し、追加候補は採用しない。CPU固有命令や設定マクロも追加しない。
measurement_limits: root共通child先読みの1000000要素APIは一部同一binarycontrolが1.6〜2倍と大きく変動したため、その条件は候補の採否・速度主張に用いない。pop-onlyは別P4で5回実行しcontrol約1.00の大規模退行を確認。公式時間だけで採用しない。全分布/CPU/コンパイラで最速と断定しない。
validation: 候補の出力照合は正しさの補助。既存最終9ec6版の12構成検証はAudit/verify-erasable-priority-queue-round2-2026-10-28.jsonに記録済み。本体を変更していないので、この同一ハッシュにのみ適用する。

normalize/decision.json.decision: reject all four candidates; retain current 9ec6
normalize/decision.json.api_validation: Each of the four candidates passed full multiset/API/ownership/aliasing/numerical boundary checks with runtime checks enabled (937784 checks) and disabled (937776 checks). GCC C++23 -O2.

pairrise.description: Interleave upward correction of both fourary heaps while both still rise, then use the original remaining correction loops.
pairrise.rejection_reason: No clear official or large API speed gain, some small cleanup regressions.

earlypush.description: After append/copy, return without writing back when first parent does not require a move, then run the original upward sift.
earlypush.rejection_reason: Small push-only gain but no clear official gain; other operations regress.

inline.description: Force normalize to inline; existing fourary pop_pair remains always_inline.
inline.rejection_reason: Native official gains within control noise; repeated top small ~5x, large ~1.11x slower. Plain official improvement does not justify regressions.

unlikely.description: Mark the normalize loop body unlikely, without changing operations.
unlikely.rejection_reason: Small layout changes; native official shifts do not exceed control noise consistently.

normalize/prefetch/poponly/decision.json.decision: reject all pop-only prefetch variants; retain current 9ec6
normalize/prefetch/poponly/decision.json.reason: Official gains reproduce, but large general API operations regress with stable baseline/control. No further prototypes.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp,json,hashlib,statistics,fcntl,shutil,random,time,os
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');fixtures=Path('/tmp/sirkit_epq_20261022/official');vs=['baseline','fullbranch','peeled'];sha=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
main=(r/'Verify/current/drivers/erasable_priority_queue_double_main.cpp').read_text().replace('#include "Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp"',(r/'Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp').read_text());builds=[]
for v in vs:
 source=p/(v+'-main.cpp');source.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+(p/(v+'.hpp')).read_text()+main)
 cmd=['taskset','-c','6','/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-march=native',str(source),'-o',str(p/(v+'-main'))]
 q=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr;builds.append(dict(variant=v,command=cmd,header_sha=sha(p/(v+'.hpp')),source_sha=sha(source),binary_sha=sha(p/(v+'-main'))))
shutil.copy2(p/'baseline-main',p/'control-main');assert sha(p/'baseline-main')==sha(p/'control-main')
validation=[]
for case in sorted((fixtures/'in').glob('*.in')):
 expected=(fixtures/'out'/(case.stem+'.out')).read_bytes()
 for v in vs:
  with case.open('rb') as f:q=sp.run([str(p/(v+'-main'))],stdin=f,stdout=sp.PIPE,check=True)
  assert q.stdout==expected,(v,case)
 validation.append(case.name)
raw=[];rng=random.Random(413713)
with open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu12.lock','a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(5):
  for case in sorted((fixtures/'in').glob('random_n*.in')):
   expected=(fixtures/'out'/(case.stem+'.out')).read_bytes();order=['baseline','control','fullbranch','peeled'];rng.shuffle(order)
   for v in order:
    out=p/'observed.out'
    with case.open('rb') as inp,out.open('wb') as f:
     start=time.perf_counter_ns();proc=sp.Popen(['taskset','-c','12',str(p/(v+'-main'))],stdin=inp,stdout=f,stderr=sp.PIPE);_,status,usage=os.wait4(proc.pid,0);proc.returncode=os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status);wall=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6;err=proc.stderr.read();proc.stderr.close()
    assert proc.returncode==0 and out.read_bytes()==expected,(case.name,v,err)
    raw.append(dict(case=case.stem,rep=rep,variant=v,cpu_ms=(usage.ru_utime+usage.ru_stime)*1000,wall_ms=wall,maxrss_kib=usage.ru_maxrss))
  print('main rep',rep,flush=True)
summary=[]
for c in sorted({x['case'] for x in raw}):
 med={v:statistics.median(x['cpu_ms'] for x in raw if x['case']==c and x['variant']==v) for v in ['baseline','control','fullbranch','peeled']}
 summary.append(dict(case=c,median_cpu_ms=med,ratio={v:t/med['baseline'] for v,t in med.items()}))
(p/'main-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(builds=builds,validation=validation,raw=raw,summary=summary),indent=2));print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
